chernoff-certified-nmax.description: certified Chernoff bound at the largest N verified

chernoff-slack-nmax.description: certified bound minus exact log R_c at the largest N verified

counting-places-nmax.description: number of counting places at the largest N verified

fixup-block-nmax.description: fixup block boundary a at the largest N verified

log-rc-nmax.description: exact log R_c at the largest N verified

lower-constant.description: 1 / (8 log phi), the T3 lower constant

n-max-verified.description: largest N at which the certified bound was verified

ratio-nmax.description: log R_c(N) / (log N)^2 at the largest N verified

residual-asymptotic-centre.description: mean residual over the samples with t >= 20 (the asymptotic regime; excludes the pre-asymptotic t=10 point)

residual-asymptotic-spread.description: max minus min residual over the samples with t >= 20

residual-asymptotic-t-min.description: smallest sampled t in the asymptotic-regime subset (t >= RESIDUAL_ASYMPTOTIC_T_MIN)

residual-centre.description: mean residual of log F_c against its leading term over the sampled t

residual-full-spread.description: max minus min residual over all sampled t in [10, 1280], including the pre-asymptotic t=10 point

residual-t-max.description: largest sampled t = log(1/s) in the residual sweep

residual-t-min.description: smallest sampled t = log(1/s) in the residual sweep

t3-lower-nmax.description: T3 construction evaluated at the largest N verified

t5-block-nmax.description: T5 block boundary a at the largest N verified

t5-log-block-nmax.description: the T5 construction's block factor -- the proved flatness bound on log B(a, m) -- at the largest N verified

t5-lower-nmax.description: T5 construction evaluated at the largest N verified

upper-constant.description: 1 / (4 log phi), the T2 upper constant
